argument: Chapter 7 is the book's source of record for skill names, yet the roster it publishes is not name-unique and the text never warns the reader. Three entries here are also Discipline labels catalogued in ch08 and ch22, and one of them, Parry, doubles as a ch09 Weapon Maneuver with its own damage-reduction and counterattack values, while this chapter keeps insisting that skills and Disciplines are different sorts of thing. The chapter also collides with itself: the Craft group heading sits directly above a Craft skill, and two detection skills are split apart, Insight filed under Social and Perception under Subterfuge, with no stated reason. Minimal fix: one disambiguating sentence in the roster introduction plus a renamed Craft heading; renaming the overlapping Disciplines or the ch09 maneuver is a larger condition, not a demand.

evidence.claim: A Weapon Maneuver of the same name as this skill exists in the abilities chapter, gated by two Blades Disciplines, and it grants flat DR and a counterattack; the roster version instead only adds its rank to a defense roll.
The Physical table defines Parry as a Brawn skill for blocking with a weapon or shield, and the attached note limits it to a roll bonus, never mentioning the identically named maneuver from ch09.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Blocking attacks with a weapon or shield; requires one in hand

evidence.claim: The Discipline catalog reuses roster words as Discipline names: Stealth, Sleight, Lore and Religion all appear as Disciplines, so the same term can mean a trained bonus or a gating discipline depending on the sentence.
The group heading and one of its members are both called Craft, so the phrase to take Craft is ambiguous between the category and the skill inside it.
Insight and Perception are both Reason-keyed detection skills, but the roster files one under Social and the other under Subterfuge, leaving the grouping rationale unstated.
The chapter twice states that a skill grants no permission of its own and that Disciplines do the gating, which makes the reuse of Discipline words as skill labels especially confusing.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: A skill never unlocks a weapon, a spell, or an ability.
